description: Generate a PDF balance statement of your activity (opening/closing balances, transactions with home-currency values, fees, FX rates) for a tax year or date range. Async: returns a requestId immediately — poll get_statement_status until it is READY to get a time-limited download link. Not tax advice.

currency.description: Statement filter: USD, EUR, CHF, CAD, MXN or CRYPTO. A currency scopes the statement to that currency's balance and activity (e.g. an 'EUR, June 2026' statement). CRYPTO lists crypto and stock trades; the currency filters leave those out, and an exchange between two currencies is on the statement of both. Omit or null for everything.

from.description: ISO-8601 start (inclusive, UTC). Required if `year` is omitted. Not before 2020-01-01.

reportingCurrency.description: Currency the amounts are valued in (USD, EUR, CHF or CAD). Defaults to the `currency` filter when it is one of those, then your account's display currency, then USD.

to.description: ISO-8601 end (exclusive, UTC). Defaults to now; a future date is clamped to now. The period can cover at most 366 days.

year.description: Tax year (Jan 1 – Dec 31 UTC). Use this OR from/to, not both.

name: generate_statement
